summary: Authenticate Agora market projector to strict source-ingest reads using env-provisioned runtime service JWT (AGORA_PROJECTOR_SERVICE_JWT / PANTHEON_AGORA_PROJECTOR_SERVICE_JWT) with role source_ingest_reader and configured tenant.

acceptance_verification.ac1_service_jwt_authenticated_reads: passed: projector authenticates connector readback and source records with runtime service JWT passing services/runtime_auth_inbound.py strict validation (role source_ingest_reader, tenant-scoped)
acceptance_verification.ac2_fail_closed_error_naming_credential: passed: missing or rejected (401/403) credential fails closed with RuntimeError explicitly naming AGORA_PROJECTOR_SERVICE_JWT, and missing tenant fails closed with RuntimeError explicitly naming PANTHEON_TENANT_ID; unauthenticated read is never performed and source guard is never weakened
acceptance_verification.ac3_compose_wiring_no_secret_default: passed: docker-compose.yml wires AGORA_PROJECTOR_SERVICE_JWT and PANTHEON_TENANT_ID with no secret default and no silent tenant default; verified by services/source_ingestion/test_compose_activation.py
acceptance_verification.ac4_isolated_l12_harness_provisioning: passed: scripts/run_isolated_l12_runtime_e2e.py provisions projector JWT signed with isolated run secret, passes tenant explicitly to projector run and token minting, and passes only to projector run via env; tokens are redacted from diagnostics and never written to evidence
acceptance_verification.ac5_test_coverage_and_isolated_run: passed: tests cover authorized read, missing credential, missing tenant, wrong role, and foreign tenant in scripts/test_project_market_data_to_bff_agora_surfaces.py and scripts/test_run_isolated_l12_runtime_e2e.py (42 tests pass). Live isolated stack projector one-shot against seeded data is recorded as pending Human/Ops execution against exact PR head outside sandbox due to worker sandbox docker rm constraint; Human/Ops will post exit code and redacted output on PR #6204.
acceptance_verification.ac6_hosted_dev_follow_up: recorded: hosted dev needs AGORA_PROJECTOR_SERVICE_JWT provisioned at deploy time as a hosted follow-up; no hosted or VM action taken
acceptance_verification.ac7_net_prod_change_budget: passed: net production change <= 60 readable lines (60 net lines across docker-compose.yml, scripts/project_market_data_to_bff_agora_surfaces.py, scripts/run_isolated_l12_runtime_e2e.py; no out-of-scope refactor, no compressed code)

hosted_track.detail: hosted dev deployment requires AGORA_PROJECTOR_SERVICE_JWT (or PANTHEON_AGORA_PROJECTOR_SERVICE_JWT) provisioned with role source_ingest_reader as a hosted follow-up; no hosted or VM action taken
